source.title: Sequences with good correlations and some open problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as URL https://zbmath.org/1642853. Direct local fetch could not resolve zbmath.org in the sandbox, so resolution used the web reader and local previously collected resolver rows.

Local zbMATH shard metadata identified record 1642853 as Sequences with good correlations and some open problems, year 2001, with no full-text links recorded. Local DBLP, OpenAlex, and Crossref shard rows identified the same exact work as Tor Helleseth, Electronic Notes in Discrete Mathematics 6:507-517, DOI 10.1016/S1571-0653(04)00203-3, DBLP key journals/endm/Helleseth01, and OpenAlex work W2048742736.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched the exact title, the exact title plus PDF, the DOI and ScienceDirect article identifier S1571065304002033, and the title plus author Helleseth. Candidate pages inspected or recovered were ScienceDirect article and PDF endpoints, DBLP volume and author records, University of Bergen/NVA publication listings, and bibliographic/index pages.

ScienceDirect exposed only an abstract and references in readable snippets; its PDF endpoint reported access-through-organization rather than readable full text. DBLP, OpenAlex, Crossref, and University of Bergen/NVA records were resolver or publication-list metadata only. Other search candidates were citations to the work, unrelated sequence-correlation papers, or non-source bibliographic pages.

Failure mode: metadata_only and paywalled_or_restricted, with local network_or_dns_failure for direct shell fetching. Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source without extracting from resolver metadata, abstracts, snippets, restricted pages, or a different work.
Saved exact JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/1642853.json and outputs/latest.json.
